band: PASS: run rate inside the reference Wilson 95% band; WARN: outside it but the run's own Wilson 95% interval overlaps the reference's; MISS: intervals disjoint
metric: ask_met = kept / (n - canary_excluded - error_screened - crashed) per (scenario, formation, model), pi launched without --no-context-files (each seat's AGENTS.md in its system prompt); never pooled with the run of record
not_frozen: the rerun's coordinator (16 original scenarios, 32 cells of ladder_ctx_n100.csv) is not frozen: the paper no longer shows or states it; its context-files figure shows the run-of-record coordinator (expected/reference.json), so a --context-files on coordinator run has no reference cell
